_what: The evidence behind REPO_NATIVE_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md section B, published so the table can be audited rather than believed. Study v2 repair for Defect E and X-25.
_authority: REPO_NATIVE_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md section B is the authority for law TEXT and CLASS. This file is the authority for the EVIDENCE COUNTS in that table.

_derivation.domains: DERIVED: distinct PROCESS_CORPUS.json `domain` values over corpus_cases. Reproduced by score_v2.py.
_derivation.non_authoring_cases: DERIVED: corpus cases whose supporting evidence was found by a channel other than authoring.
_derivation.operational: DECLARED and ENUMERATED: len(operational_instances). Each entry names a gate, type, scanner or refusal in code.
_derivation.failures: DECLARED and ENUMERATED: len(failures_explained). Each entry names a real failure in this repository.

_note: `operational` and `failures` are enumerated rather than derived from a machine pass. They are auditable one by one and they are not reproducible by a command. That is a real limitation of D2's inputs and it is recorded in SCORING_METHOD_V2.md section 0-E.

RNL-01.title: Derive, don't declare
RNL-01.statement: State that can be computed from the record is computed, not asserted; where it genuinely cannot be, the exception is named, guarded at the layer that owns the race, and never re-derived.

RNL-06.title: Identity follows semantics, not labels
RNL-06.statement: A thing's identity is a function of what it commits to. Change the commitment and the identity changes; keep the commitment and a rename changes nothing.

RNL-08.title: Evidence authority may never exceed evidence level
RNL-08.statement: What a claim is ALLOWED to become is bounded by what was done to it, and the bound is enforced rather than remembered.

RNL-14.title: The level of reality in the test must match the level in the claim
RNL-14.statement: A claim is evidence only at the rung its proof actually ran against; the rung is derived, and a severity implies a floor.
